name: value-utilities/colors
description: Color utilities for `bg-`, `text-`, `border-`. Exercises the full default palette (slate/red/blue/.../rose with shades 50..950), the special keywords (transparent, current, inherit, black, white), opacity modifiers (named `/50` -> theme.opacity.50 = 0.5; arbitrary `/[.31]` -> literal), arbitrary hex (`text-[#ef4444]`), arbitrary rgb (`bg-[rgb(0_0_0_/_0.5)]`). Mirrors `corePlugins.js`'s backgroundColor/textColor/borderColor plugins driven by `withAlphaVariable.js`.
